verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is general data management. The Data page lets you open table records, and the SDK exposes CRUD operations on app entities, which implies you can delete records you own inside an app. Nothing in the pack addresses retention policies or deleting the data the platform itself holds. missing for 10: documented retention policies or settings, account/app-level data deletion or purge controls, control over retention of AI prompts and chat data, independent corroboration.
